jev_question.instructions: Determine whether the user's design prompt, UI inspiration, or target surface belongs to the macOS Desktop platform (`desktop`). Consider host containers (`MenuBarExtra`, `NSPopover`, `NSWindow`, multi-column `NavigationSplitView`, `Inspector`), pointer/hover + keyboard shortcut (`⌘`) ergonomics, compact 28-36pt controls, and 13pt base typography.

criteria.true: The prompt targets or describes a macOS desktop experience, window/popover utility, multi-pane split view, pointer-hover choreography, keyboard-first workflow, or desktop status-bar surface.
criteria.false: The prompt exclusively targets touch-first iOS/iPadOS mobile screens (single-hand thumb zone, 44pt targets, bottom tabs/sheets) or browser-based Web/DOM/video rendering pipelines.

jev_question.instructions: Determine whether the user's design prompt, UI inspiration, or target surface belongs to the iOS/iPadOS Mobile platform (`mobile`). Consider touch gestures (tap, drag, long-press, swipe), 44x44pt minimum hit targets, 17pt body / >=11pt minimum font sizes, haptic `SensoryFeedback`, and mobile host containers (`NavigationStack`, `TabView`, `Sheet`, `Widget/LiveActivity`, single-hand dense entry).

criteria.true: The prompt targets or is applicable to an iOS/iPadOS touch interface, mobile app screen, gesture-driven micro-interaction, single-hand entry surface, sheet/tab flow, or Live Activity/Widget.
criteria.false: The prompt is exclusively for a desktop-only macOS status bar utility or window chrome, or exclusively for a browser DOM/WebGL/video offline rendering pipeline.

web.label_zh: Web 与视频渲染管线 (Backlog 冻结)

jev_question.instructions: Determine whether the user's prompt targets a browser-based Web interface (`Viewport`, `DOM/Canvas/WebGL`, SaaS dashboard, editorial blog) or an offline Code-to-Video rendering pipeline (`RemotionComposition`, `Three.js`, `Manim`, `FFmpeg`). Note that this platform track is currently `backlog-frozen`.

criteria.true: The prompt explicitly requests HTML/CSS/React/DOM web pages, WebGL 3D scenes in a browser, or offline programmatic video/audio generation via Remotion/Manim/FFmpeg.
criteria.false: The prompt requests native Apple platform UI, interactions, or data visualization for macOS (`desktop`) or iOS/iPadOS (`mobile`).

noise_gate.action_on_trip: Drop segment immediately with reason='jev_noise' before any dimension scoring or LLM invocation.

fast_path_thresholds.compound_count_rule: compound_dimension_count = count(dim for dim in dimensions if dim.dimension_confidence >= 0.55)
fast_path_thresholds.fast_path_action: Directly emit single atomic catalog card using the top dimension's prefix (CL/VS/CP/DV/GM/MI/LN/TC), sub_category, and Apple Native / Web implementation templates without calling the fallback LLM.

llm_fallback_triggers: jev_unavailable_or_timeout: HTTP POST to /v1/systemone fails or exceeds 1500ms timeout.
low_platform_confidence: platform_confidence < 0.70 (ambiguous whether inspiration targets desktop macOS, mobile iOS, web, or shared).
compound_multi_dimension_prompt: compound_dimension_count > 1 (two or more dimensions score >= 0.55, e.g. a prompt mixing Liquid Glass + Swift Charts cross-filtering + spring gesture).
unsplit_prose_paragraph: Input exceeds 140 characters without bullet markers and matches keywords from >= 2 orthogonal dimensions.

llm_decomposition_prompt_template.system_prompt:
You are the Design Studio Orthogonal Taxonomy Decomposer. Given raw, unlabeled design inspiration (user text, screenshot OCR, or markdown notes), decompose it into 1 to N atomic, single-responsibility design cards across the 8 canonical dimensions: `color-palette` (CL), `visual-style` (VS), `component` (CP), `chart-dataviz` (DV), `glass-material` (GM), `motion-interaction` (MI), `layout-navigation` (LN), and `typography-copy` (TC).

Rules:
1. If the input mixes multiple dimensions (e.g., a Liquid Glass toolbar + spring scrubbing magnification + tabular numeric badge), split it into distinct atomic cards so each card has exactly ONE `primary_dimension`.
2. Implementations MUST use pure Apple Native APIs (SwiftUI, Swift Charts, SF Symbols, `.glassEffect`, `GlassEffectContainer`, System Semantic Colors, Dynamic Type, `ContentUnavailableView`, `SensoryFeedback`, `NavigationSplitView`) — NEVER reference custom `Strata*` wrapper types.
3. Extract 1–4 domain-specific trigger terms not yet in our keyword bank into `new_keywords_to_learn`.
4. Return ONLY valid JSON matching the schema.
llm_decomposition_prompt_template.user_prompt_template:
Raw Inspiration Input:
"""
{{raw_input_text}}
"""

Jev Pre-Classification Signal:
{{jev_signal_json}}

Allowed Dimensions & Sub-Categories:
{{taxonomy_dimensions_summary_json}}

Decompose into atomic cards using this exact JSON schema:
{
  "is_valid_design_inspiration": true,
  "atomic_cards": [
    {
      "platform": ["macos", "ios", "web", "shared"],
      "primary_dimension": "color-palette | visual-style | component | chart-dataviz | glass-material | motion-interaction | layout-navigation | typography-copy",
      "secondary_dimensions": [],
      "sub_category": "<exact sub_category slug from taxonomy>",
      "title_zh": "<concise Chinese title>",
      "title_en": "<concise English title>",
      "canonical_prompt": "<normalized, deterministic English specification>",
      "state_machine": "<state_a -> event -> state_b>",
      "desktop_macos_implementation": "<pure macOS SwiftUI / AppKit / Swift Charts / Liquid Glass implementation>",
      "mobile_ios_implementation": "<pure iOS SwiftUI / Swift Charts / Liquid Glass / SensoryFeedback implementation>",
      "hig_routes": ["<relevant Apple HIG .md filenames>"],
      "new_keywords_to_learn": ["<novel zh/en trigger phrase 1>", "<novel zh/en trigger phrase 2>"]
    }
  ]
}

validation_gates: Card was accepted into catalog (not rejected as noise and not aborted in dry-run).
Candidate keyword length is between 2 and 32 characters after normalization (`.strip().casefold()` for ASCII, exact trim for CJK).
Candidate keyword is not in global stopwords (`['UI', '设计', '效果', '页面', 'app', 'view', 'style', 'design']`).
Cross-dimension orthogonality check: candidate keyword does not already appear in `keywords_zh_en` of any OTHER dimension (prevents ambiguity pollution).
writeback_procedure: 2. Check if already present in `dimensions[primary_dimension].keywords_zh_en`; if present, increment its hit counter in `staging_ledger` and skip file mutation.

3. If novel and passes all `validation_gates`: when `llm_decomposition_confidence >= 0.85` (or `--force-learn` is set, or candidate reaches `occurrence_count >= 2` in `staging_ledger`), append deterministically to `dimensions[primary_dimension].keywords_zh_en` in `taxonomy-v2.json` sorted lexicographically after core anchors.
4. Update `taxonomy-v2.json` top-level `updated` ISO-8601 date and write atomically with 2-space UTF-8 formatting (`ensure_ascii=False`).

my-designer.role: Primary orchestrator and slot-based design specification generator for macOS (`desktop`) and iOS/iPadOS (`mobile`) surfaces, stripped of legacy Strata* wrapper references and web/editorial slots.

design-studio.role: Structured interactive pattern (`MP-*`, `IP-*`) and motion/tooling catalog (`T-*`) with CLI search/recommendation and telemetry tracking.

visual-design-modernization.role: Visual polish, hierarchy, surface elevation, and anti-generic modernization heuristics folded directly into the core Apple design workflow.

hig.role: Authoritative Apple Human Interface Guidelines reference covering macOS and iOS/iPadOS layout, typography, hit targets, semantic color, and accessibility.

ios-liquid-glass.role: Specialized Apple Native Liquid Glass implementation reference (`glassEffect`, `GlassEffectContainer`, `glassEffectID`, `NSGlassEffectView`, and Reduce Transparency fallbacks).

guide-swiftui-charts.role: Specialized Apple Native Swift Charts implementation reference (`Chart`, selection bindings, marks, custom axes, and cross-filtering).

apple-design-reviewer.role: Post-implementation visual and code audit skill verifying Apple HIG compliance, Light/Dark parity, hit-target geometry, and native API usage on macOS and iOS.

dataviz-principles.role: Platform-agnostic perceptual data visualization rules (series vs. semantic status color separation, scale honesty, ink-to-data ratio, tabular numerals).

impeccable.role: Web/CSS-centric UI polish and frontend craft rules deferred to the frozen web track.

ui-ux-pro-max.role: Broad web/landing-page/SaaS template and CSS palette generator deferred to the frozen web track.
